lane:
شلياق

الشلياق الشَّلْيَاقُ _A certain northern constellation,_ [namely, _Lyra,_] _consisting of ten stars, the bright star_ [alpha] _of which is called_ النَّسْرُ الوَاقِعُ: _the Arabs liken it to a vulture_ (نَسْر) _which has contracted its wings to itself, as though it had alighted upon a thing: the vulgar call_ [_the three chief stars in_] _it_ الأَثَافِى: _and before the bright star is a dim star which the Arabs call_ الأَظْفَار [i. e. _the talons_]. (Kzw. [Not in any of my Lexicons.])
